stem.en: Machine learning is best described as:

options.en: A subset of AI in which computers learn from data

explanation.en: ML is the part of AI where the system learns patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules.

stem.en: Which of these is an application of natural language processing?

options.en: Translating an English sentence into Hindi

explanation.en: Machine translation works with human language, so it is NLP.

stem.en: The data used to check how accurate a trained ML model is, is called:

explanation.en: Testing data is kept aside and not used in training, so it shows how well the model works on new data.

solution.en: Testing data is kept aside and not used in training, so it shows how well the model works on new data.

stem.en: A shopping website shows "customers who bought this also bought…". This is an example of:

explanation.en: Recommendations are predictions made by models that learn from past purchase data.

stem.en: A technology that overlays computer-generated images on a live view of the real world is:

explanation.en: AR augments (adds to) the real-world view; VR replaces it.

stem.en: A flight simulator in which a trainee is surrounded by a computer-generated cockpit and sky uses:

explanation.en: The whole environment is computer-generated and replaces reality, so it is VR.

solution.en: The whole environment is computer-generated and replaces reality, so it is VR.

stem.en: A drone is an example of:

explanation.en: A drone is an unmanned aerial vehicle, flown by remote or autonomously.

stem.en: Which statement about robots is correct?

options.en: Robots can carry out complex actions automatically using sensors and actuators

explanation.en: Robots sense with sensors and act with actuators; most robots, like factory arms or rovers, are not humanoid.

stem.en: Which characteristic of big data refers to the speed at which data is generated?

explanation.en: Velocity is the rate at which data is produced and must be processed.

stem.en: The fact that big data includes text, images, audio and video refers to its:

explanation.en: Variety means many types and formats of data.

stem.en: Examining data to find patterns and draw conclusions is called:

explanation.en: This is the definition of data analytics.

stem.en: Which "V" of big data is about how accurate and trustworthy the data is?

explanation.en: Veracity concerns the quality and reliability of the data.

solution.en: Veracity concerns the quality and reliability of the data.

stem.en:
Assertion (A): Big data cannot be handled efficiently by traditional database tools.
Reason (R): Big data has very large volume, high velocity and a wide variety of formats.

options.en: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

explanation.en: Both are true, and the size, speed and mixed formats are exactly what overwhelm traditional tools.

stem.en: Fake and mistaken customer ratings in the app's data relate to which characteristic of big data?

explanation.en: Questionable accuracy of data is a veracity issue.

passage.en: A food-delivery company in Bengaluru receives about 2 lakh orders a day. Every second, the app records riders' GPS locations, order status, payments and customer ratings. It also stores restaurant photos, menu text and voice complaints. Some ratings are fake or entered by mistake. The company analyses this data to predict busy hours and to place riders near popular restaurants.

stem.en: Predicting busy hours and placing riders near popular restaurants is an example of:

options.en: Data analytics extracting value from big data

explanation.en: Analysing the data to support business decisions turns big data into value.

passage.en: A food-delivery company in Bengaluru receives about 2 lakh orders a day. Every second, the app records riders' GPS locations, order status, payments and customer ratings. It also stores restaurant photos, menu text and voice complaints. Some ratings are fake or entered by mistake. The company analyses this data to predict busy hours and to place riders near popular restaurants.

stem.en: A network of everyday devices that collect and exchange data over the Internet is called:

explanation.en: This is the definition of IoT.

stem.en: Which sensor in a smartphone senses tilt so that the screen rotates?

explanation.en: The accelerometer measures acceleration and tilt, which is used for auto-rotation and step counting.

stem.en: Which sensor switches off the touch screen when you hold the phone to your ear?

explanation.en: The proximity sensor detects that something (your ear) is close to the screen.

stem.en: The Web of Things differs from IoT because it:

options.en: Uses web standards so devices can be accessed through web services and browsers

explanation.en: WoT builds on IoT by using web technologies to connect and control devices.

solution.en: WoT builds on IoT by using web technologies to connect and control devices.

stem.en: Using an online email service through a web browser is an example of:

explanation.en: The complete application is delivered over the Internet, so it is SaaS.

stem.en: Renting virtual machines and storage from a cloud provider is:

explanation.en: Virtual hardware resources are Infrastructure as a Service.

stem.en: Which is a key feature of cloud computing?

options.en: Resources are delivered over the Internet on demand
It works only without the Internet
Data is stored only on a pen drive

explanation.en: Cloud resources are on-demand and accessed over the Internet, often pay-per-use.

stem.en: A bank sets up a cloud only for its own branches and staff. This is a:

explanation.en: A cloud used by a single organisation is a private cloud.

solution.en: A cloud used by a single organisation is a private cloud.

stem.en:
Assertion (A): In SaaS, the user does not need to install the software on their computer.
Reason (R): SaaS applications run on the provider's servers and are used through the Internet, usually in a browser.

options.en: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

explanation.en: Both true; because the software runs on the provider's servers, nothing is installed locally.

stem.en: Renting virtual machines and storage by the hour is which cloud service?

explanation.en: Virtual hardware on rent is IaaS.

passage.en: A start-up in Mysuru builds a school-attendance app. Instead of buying servers, it rents virtual machines and storage from a cloud provider by the hour. Its developers use a ready online platform with a database and web server already set up, so they only write and deploy their code. The schools that buy the app simply open it in a browser and pay a monthly fee; they install nothing.

stem.en: For the schools that open the attendance app in a browser and pay monthly, the app is:

explanation.en: A ready application delivered over the Internet on subscription is SaaS. (The developers' ready platform is PaaS.)

passage.en: A start-up in Mysuru builds a school-attendance app. Instead of buying servers, it rents virtual machines and storage from a cloud provider by the hour. Its developers use a ready online platform with a database and web server already set up, so they only write and deploy their code. The schools that buy the app simply open it in a browser and pay a monthly fee; they install nothing.

stem.en: Each block in a blockchain stores, along with its data:

options.en: Its own hash and the hash of the previous block
A copy of the operating system

explanation.en: The previous block's hash links the blocks into a chain.

stem.en: A grid that shares processing power of many computers is a:

explanation.en: A CPU or processor grid pools computing power.

stem.en: Which is an application of blockchain?

explanation.en: Blockchains keep shared, tamper-evident records such as land ownership.

stem.en: Which statement about grid computing is correct?

options.en: All nodes must be in one room
Nodes are geographically dispersed and may be heterogeneous
It can use only one computer
It is a type of virtual reality

explanation.en: Grids join loosely coupled, dispersed, often different computers.

solution.en: Grids join loosely coupled, dispersed, often different computers.

stem.en: Why is a blockchain called decentralised?

options.en: Each participating node holds a copy of the ledger and no single authority controls it
It is stored only on one central server

explanation.en: Copies are distributed across nodes and agreed upon collectively.

stem.en: Which of the following is NOT one of the five characteristics (Vs) of big data?

explanation.en: The five Vs of big data are Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity and Value. Visibility is not one of them.

solution.en: The five Vs of big data are Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity and Value.
Visibility is not one of them.

stem.en:
Match the cloud service with its example.
(A) IaaS  (B) PaaS  (C) SaaS
(i) Writing a document in an online word processor through a browser
(ii) Renting virtual machines and storage space
(iii) Using an online platform with tools to build and deploy an app

explanation.en: IaaS provides raw infrastructure such as virtual machines and storage; PaaS gives a platform to build and deploy apps; SaaS gives ready software used through a browser.

solution.en: IaaS provides raw infrastructure such as virtual machines and storage; PaaS gives a platform to build and deploy apps; SaaS gives ready software used through a browser.

stem.en:
Consider the statements about a blockchain:
I. Each block stores the hash of the previous block.
II. A blockchain is kept by a single central authority.
III. Changing the data in a block changes its hash.
Which of them are correct?

explanation.en: A blockchain is decentralised: every node keeps a copy, so II is false. Each block holds the previous block’s hash, and any change to a block’s data changes its hash, so I and III are true.

stem.en: An email service learns to move unwanted mail to the spam folder from millions of examples marked by users. This is:

explanation.en: The filter learns patterns from labelled examples, which is machine learning.

stem.en: Augmented reality hides the real world completely and shows only a simulated one.

explanation.en: That is VR. AR keeps the real world and adds digital information to it.

stem.en: In the fruit program, what does predict(160, 6) return?

explanation.en: The nearest training example is (150, 7, apple): distance √(100 + 100) ≈ 14.1, smaller than all others.

stem.en: A fitness band sends your step count and heart rate to an app on your phone. This is an example of:

explanation.en: A physical device collects data and shares it over a network: IoT.

stem.en: Data from a hospital includes X-ray images, typed notes, lab values in tables and voice recordings. Which V does this show most?

explanation.en: Many different types and formats of data is variety.

stem.en: A smart sensor can process its readings itself before sending them.

explanation.en: A smart sensor has a built-in processor, unlike a simple sensor that only produces a signal.

stem.en: In the street-light program, what does the lamp show for a reading of 100 lux?

explanation.en: The condition is lux < 100; 100 is not less than 100, so the lamp is OFF.

stem.en: Big data is worth collecting only if analysing it gives useful insight.

explanation.en: That is the fifth V, value.

stem.en: A company rents virtual servers and installs its own operating system on them. This is:

explanation.en: Only infrastructure is provided; the user manages the OS and software.

stem.en: Which is an example of SaaS?

explanation.en: SaaS is finished software for end users; the others are infrastructure.

options.en: Using an online spreadsheet in a browser

stem.en: In a blockchain, a single central authority keeps the only copy of the ledger.

explanation.en: A blockchain is decentralised: every node keeps a copy, so there is no single owner.

stem.en: In the Python blockchain model, why does Chain valid: print False?

explanation.en: Hashing is deterministic: the same input always gives the same hash, so only a change in data changes the hash.

options.en: The first block's data was changed, so its new hash differs from the previous-hash in block 2
SHA-256 always gives a random value
The chain has only three blocks

stem.en: Which technology lets a farmer's soil-moisture sensor turn on a pump and send an alert to her phone?

explanation.en: A sensor-equipped device acting and communicating over the internet is IoT.

stem.en: "Some online reviews in the data set are fake." Which V of big data is this about?

explanation.en: Doubtful accuracy of data is a veracity issue.

stem.en: SaaS users must install and maintain the operating system on the provider's servers.

explanation.en: In SaaS the provider manages everything; users just use the software. Managing the OS is the user's job in IaaS.

stem.en: A headset shows a full 3D simulation of the Hampi ruins while you sit at home. This is:

explanation.en: The real surroundings are replaced by a simulated world.
